title: DNA and Water Transfer with CSV File
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your CSV and input your protocol parameters.
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Attach required pipettes
steps.instruction: Confirm that the P10 single‑channel pipette and the P300 (P50) single‑channel pipette are mounted on the robot.

steps.title: Load deck with required labware
steps.instruction: Place the following labware on the OT‑2 deck as shown in the protocol deck map: GEB 96 tip rack 10 µL, Opentrons 96 tip rack 300 µL (or equivalent VWR universal pipet tips 10 µL and 300 µL), VWR flat 96‑well PCR plate 200 µL, VWR microplate 96‑square 2 mL, and an EK Scientific reservoir without lid (290 mL).

steps.title: Prepare CSV file
steps.instruction: Create a CSV file with four columns exactly named: `Samples`, `DNA Stock Volume (µL)`, `H20 Stock Volume (µL)`, and `Well`. Fill each row with the sample identifier, the volume of DNA stock (in µL), the volume of water (in µL), and the destination well (e.g., A1, B1, C1, …).

steps.title: Set protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the OT‑2 protocol builder, upload the prepared CSV file and specify the mount (left or right) for the P10 pipette and for the P300 (P50) pipette.

steps.title: Generate and download protocol
steps.instruction: After setting the parameters, click the button to generate the OT‑2 protocol and download the resulting JSON file.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons OT‑2 Run App (version 3.15.0 or later) and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, run the calibration routine for the deck map, tip racks, and both pipettes. Use calibration tips as described in the support articles.

steps.title: Execute the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the transfer of DNA stock and water to the 96‑well PCR plate according to the CSV instructions.
